items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Noble Sissons tried to bring that up in New York... See, with Noble up on that. How about him? He's running New York.

ctx.x: I'd like to say that, that came out.

You see, there's a lot of the guys, see now we, there's something else we used to do down there. Because all the bands down there had their uniforms and their names on the cap of the band. Yeah. See, now that came out of New York, Noble Sissons tried to bring that up in New York, because the band come back from overseas, he had the bands with the caps on them. See, with Noble up on that. How about him? He's running New York. He's running for president once, but he didn't get the first base. He would have made it.…
